scope: Proposed architecture evidence only; not implementation or therapeutic validation.

entries.bounded_claim: Passive digital measures are an active research input, but missingness, reporting variability, small samples, and limited generalizability constrain inference.
entries.does_not_establish: That passive signals reveal current mood, need, diagnosis, or a safe intervention choice.

entries.bounded_claim: Electrodermal-activity models in the reviewed literature estimate arousal more successfully than valence and often mismatch continuous affect theory with classification methods.
entries.does_not_establish: A person-independent emotion decoder or an objective description of felt experience.

entries.bounded_claim: Lab Streaming Layer provides an established interface for time-synchronized multimodal recording.
entries.does_not_establish: Sensor validity, emotional interpretation, or inclusion in the MVP.

entries.bounded_claim: Recursive Bayesian filtering can combine multiple observations while retaining uncertainty in a shared-control task.
entries.does_not_establish: That assistive-robot intent inference transfers reliably to affect or music.

entries.bounded_claim: JITAI design distinguishes decision points, tailoring variables, intervention options, decision rules, and proximal outcomes.
entries.does_not_establish: An effective Antidote decision rule or therapeutic outcome.

entries.bounded_claim: Model predictive control supplies a precedent for explicit models, finite-horizon optimization, constraints, and repeated replanning.
entries.does_not_establish: That affect is a known controllable plant or that the proposed objective is valid.

entries.bounded_claim: POMDPs formalize action selection when state is only partially observed and represented as a belief distribution.
entries.does_not_establish: A tractable or ethically acceptable autonomous affect policy.

entries.subsystem: editable state, intent, and recommendation interface
entries.bounded_claim: Interactive-machine-learning design benefits from studying and involving end users throughout system development.
entries.does_not_establish: That user feedback is complete, unbiased, or automatically improves trust.

entries.bounded_claim: In one controlled interactive-ML study, soliciting feedback reduced trust and perceived accuracy regardless of model improvement.
entries.does_not_establish: That Antidote knobs will reduce trust or that feedback should be removed.

entries.bounded_claim: Mustango demonstrates text-to-music conditioning with explicit chord, beat, tempo, and key instructions and evaluates adherence.
entries.does_not_establish: Exact control realization, continuous prompt mixing, or felt-state change.

entries.bounded_claim: JASCO combines global text with fine-grained local symbolic and audio conditions for temporally controlled generation.
entries.does_not_establish: Real-time generation, open local viability, or emotional benefit.

entries.bounded_claim: MusicGen provides a reproducible architecture reference for text- and melody-conditioned music generation.
entries.does_not_establish: Commercially usable weights, moment-specific control, or long continuous journeys.

entries.bounded_claim: ACE-Step 1.5 reports long-duration local generation and explicit musical controls relevant to future benchmarking.
entries.does_not_establish: Selection as the production model or verified capability on Antidote hardware.

entries.bounded_claim: A 2026 preprint proposes low-latency chunk-wise music generation that accepts changing human inputs while preserving temporal consistency.
entries.does_not_establish: Independent replication, production readiness, local performance, or compatibility with Antidote.

entries.bounded_claim: An evaluated adaptive game-music system demonstrates context-responsive real-time composition as an established neighboring design space.
entries.does_not_establish: Seamless segment interpolation or transfer from gameplay to affective support.

entries.bounded_claim: Web Audio defines scheduled parameter automation and render-thread processing concepts relevant to sample-accurate playback.
entries.does_not_establish: Antidote conformance or musical and emotional continuity.

entries.bounded_claim: EBU R 128 supplies a normative loudness-measurement and normalization reference.
entries.does_not_establish: A universal listening level, transition method, or safety threshold.

entries.bounded_claim: Scroll separates lossless history, durable payloads, derived state, and a bounded working view while documenting retrieval failures.
entries.does_not_establish: Health-data privacy, consent quality, or correct psychological interpretation.

entries.bounded_claim: Local-first software provides a peer-reviewed architecture rationale for local ownership and offline-capable data access.
entries.does_not_establish: Encryption, deletion, privacy compliance, or Antidote security.

entries.subsystem: append-only event authority and rebuildable views
entries.bounded_claim: Authoritative engineering guidance describes immutable append-only events and state reconstruction by replay.
entries.does_not_establish: Scientific validity, tamper evidence, or privacy.

entries.bounded_claim: W3C PROV defines entities, activities, agents, derivations, responsibility, and provenance bundles.
entries.does_not_establish: That recorded assertions are true or that Antidote conforms.

entries.bounded_claim: Workflow Run RO-Crate demonstrates packaging computational workflow provenance for traceability and reproducibility.
entries.does_not_establish: Participant privacy review, semantic correctness, or a complete Antidote export.
